task.title: Your task
task.confirmBody: You will not be able to return to this shop afterwards.
common.desktopOnly.title: Please use a computer
common.desktopOnly.body: This study needs a larger screen. Please open this link on a laptop or desktop computer, or make your browser window wider.
study.title: Online shopping study
study.invalidLink.title: This link is not valid
study.invalidLink.body: Please check that you copied the whole link from your invitation, or contact the research team.
study.error.title: Something went wrong
study.error.body: Your answers so far are saved. Please reload the page to continue.
consent.mustAgree: Please tick the box to continue.
bg.title: About you
bg.intro: A few questions about you and how you use websites. There are no right or wrong answers.
bg.ageInvalid: Please enter an age between 18 and 99.
bg.field: What is your field of study or work?
bg.fieldHint: For example: nursing, accounting, history. Leave empty if it does not apply.
bg.csOrIt: Do you study or work in computer science, software or IT?
bg.techConfidence: How confident are you using computers and websites?
bg.shopping: How often do you shop online?
bg.prefsIntro: Which of these would you prefer on a shopping website?
instr.title: How this works
instr.p1: You will see two short videos of a shop changing its look. Pick the version you would rather use. There are no right or wrong answers.
instr.p2: Both videos play at the same time and last a few seconds. When they have finished, choose A (left) or B (right). You can replay them as often as you like.
instr.p3: You can also use the keyboard: ← for A and → for B.
instr.p4: First you will do {count} practice comparisons.
mainIntro.title: Practice complete
mainIntro.body: Now the real comparisons begin. There are {count} comparisons, with {breaks} short breaks along the way. Please answer based on which shop you would rather use.
trial.question: Which version of the shop would you rather use?
trial.questionChooseB: For this trial, please choose B.
trial.watchFirst: Please watch both videos to the end before choosing.
trial.videoError: A video could not be loaded.
break.title: Take a short break
break.body: You have completed {done} of {total} comparisons. Rest your eyes for a moment, then continue when you are ready.
end.title: Thank you!
end.phase1: You have completed the study. Please keep this completion code:
end.sessionA: You have completed the first session. We will contact you to schedule the second session.
end.close: You can now close this window.
sb.locked.title: Welcome
sb.locked.body: The researcher will start the session in a moment. Please wait.
sb.welcome.title: Welcome to the second session
sb.welcome.p1: In this session you will do four short shopping tasks in an online shop. Each task has a shopping list and a budget.
sb.welcome.p2: The shop may change its appearance while you use it. Just carry on shopping as you normally would.
sb.welcome.p3: After each task you will answer a few questions about the shop you just used. At the end you will compare the four shops.
sb.welcome.p4: First, there is a short practice task so you can get to know the shop. It does not count.
q.progress: Questions about the shop in task {number}
q.missing: Please answer all questions. {count} still need an answer.
rank.title: Compare the four shops
rank.intro: Here are the four shops you used, in the order you used them. Put them in order from the one you liked most (top) to the one you liked least (bottom). Drag a shop, or use the arrow buttons.
end.sessionB: You have completed the session. Thank you very much for taking part.
home.body: Please use the personal link you received to take part.
